root_cause: The combined ledger and 18 open PRs exposed redundant metadata retrieval within a single bounded reconciliation.
repair: Reuse open-PR list payloads, immutable commit metadata returned during contributor enumeration, distinct-head workflow lists, and already observed run headers. Retain all review/contributor, evidence-job, artifact and end-of-snapshot checks. No cross-observation cache, hidden retry, or budget increase.
additional_premerge_finding: Evidence/knowledge branches contain legacy incomplete v1 handoffs. A read-only adapter retains source digests, date precision and blockers. It rejects legacy PASS and malformed input; historical files are not rewritten. Candidate preflight must check handoff readability before adoption.
recovery_note: Inspect exact new-head CI and actual request counts before claiming recovery. This failure record remains historical.
